name: City Magi (Warmage Archetype)
body:
You have sworn to protect the citizenry of your district, gaining power and influence from your commitment to the welfare of the community and upholding its laws.

Officer Training: A city magi gains Knowledge (dungeoneering), Knowledge (local), and Knowledge (nature) as class skills. This alters the warmage’s class skills.

Officer Identity: At 1st level, a city magi has an official identity as a member of the local city guard or watch.

Officer identity functions as a city magi’s social identity and vigilante identity, of the vigilante class, for the renown social talent and any social talents the city magi possesses that lists renown as a prerequisite. A city magi’s effective vigilante level for the effects of social talents and for meeting the prerequisites of a social talent is equal to their class level.

District: At 1st level, a city magi gains the renown social talent. A city magi must select 1 settlement as the center of their jurisdiction from which their renown and reputation spreads. The area in which a city magi’s renown and officer identity applies is known as their district. All of the city magi’s supernatural and spell-like arcane strategies, except for familiar arcane strategy and any that adds spells to their spell list, are only usable or functional within the boundaries of their district. A city magi can change the center of their district by selecting a new settlement as described in the renown social talent.

As a city magi grows in reputation and personal power, the size of their district increases. At 6th level, a city magi gains the great renown social talent. At 11th level, a city magi gains the incredible renown social talent.

This ability replaces the focused mind bonuses gained at 2nd and 9th levels and the bonus feat gained at 4th level.

Urban Arcane Strategy: A city magi gains access to the following arcane strategies.
Covert Tactics: You add one enchantment spell available to the wizard to each spell level you possess or later gain, including cantrips, of your spell list. Each such spell must still be learned and added to your spellbook normally. This arcane strategy can be selected multiple times, granting new spells for each level.
Social Climber: You may choose a social talent that lists renown as a prerequisite and for which you meet all other prerequisites. This arcane strategy can be selected multiple times, granting a different social talent each time.
Urban Warfare (Su)

As a free action, you may choose one of the following two effects below as you cast an appropriate spell. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Intelligence modifier.

This arcane strategy can be selected up to 3 times, gaining an additional 3 daily uses instead each time.

Meticulous Magi: You may choose to have a spell you cast that deals damage (or otherwise harms life) not damage (or harm) normal and magical objects.
Efficient Magi: Whenever you cast a spell that utilizes, repairs, or enhances normal or magical objects (such as animate rope or arcane lock), you cast the spell at +1 caster level.
Code of Conduct: A city magi is expected to follow and uphold the legal protocols and laws of their district.

Should a city magi’s illegal activities or betrayal of the trust of the citizens of their district become public, they lose access to their arcane strategies and social talents.

This penalty persists until a city magi receives a legal pardon or they have relocated to a different nation to change the location of their renown.
